description: Identify internal and external factors that are favorable and unfavorable to achieving goals.

recommendations.description: A list of specific actions that address weaknesses, mitigate threats, and capitalize on opportunities. Each action should be actionable, time-bound, and assigned to an owner.
recommendations.title: Recommendations

strategic_objectives.description: Specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound (SMART) goals that the project aims to achieve. These objectives should be directly informed by the SWOT analysis and provide a roadmap for action.
strategic_objectives.title: Strategic Objectives

assumptions.description: Hypotheses or conditions taken as true for the purpose of this SWOT. If any assumption changes, the analysis may need updating.
assumptions.title: Assumptions

missing_information.description: Gaps in data, research, or stakeholder input. If these gaps are filled, the accuracy and utility of this SWOT will improve.
missing_information.title: Missing Information

user_questions.description: Five crucial, thought-provoking questions to guide the user in identifying and evaluating strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats.
user_questions.title: User Questions

title: SWOTAnalysis
